summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by setting dimensions for MatrixSymbol inputs if not provided, which resolves the reported problem without introducing obvious issues.

issues.description: The patch assumes that all MatrixSymbol inputs should have dimensions set based on their shape, which might not cover all edge cases where dimensions could be explicitly defined differently.

The patch directly modifies the constructor of the Variable class, which might not align with the intended design or conventions of the codebase. It could be more explicit or use a different method to handle this case.
